title: What is the lump on your charger cable?
hook: Look near the end of your laptop charger. That thick bump is not there for grip.

title: Why are car tyres black?
hook: Rubber is not naturally black. So why does every tyre on the road look the same?

title: Why is one pin on a UK plug longer?
hook: Look at a UK plug. The top pin is longer than the other two, and it has a job.

title: Why do some plug pins have a hole in them?
hook: Look closely at the metal pins of a European plug. Each one has a tiny hole near the tip.

title: Why do coins have ridged edges?
hook: Run your finger along a coin's edge. Those grooves were once a security feature.

title: Why do USB plugs never fit the first time?
hook: You try it. Wrong way. You flip it. Still wrong. There is a reason.

title: Why does your SIM card have a cut corner?
hook: Every SIM card has one clipped corner. It is not a design flourish.

title: Why does the petrol pump stop by itself?
hook: No sensor, no battery. The nozzle clicks off the instant your tank is full.

title: Why do light bulbs screw in?
hook: Most plugs just push in. Why do light bulbs twist into the socket?

title: Why is the headphone jack older than the radio?
hook: The little jack on your headphones was first made for telephone switchboards.

title: Why is the bottom of a wine bottle pushed in?
hook: That dent in the bottom of a wine bottle has a name. People still argue about why it is there.

title: Why are traffic cones orange?
hook: Not red, not yellow. Why did the whole world pick orange for traffic cones?

title: Why does your weather app have a 'feels like' temperature?
hook: Your phone says 12 degrees but feels like 8. Who invented that number?

title: Why do vegetables end up on top in a pressure cooker?
hook: Open a pressure cooker and the rice is at the bottom and the vegetables are on top. Every time.

title: Why does your car windscreen have black dots around the edge?
hook: Look at the edge of your windscreen. The black dots fade out in a pattern. It is on purpose.

title: Why do some ice cubes have a hole in the middle?
hook: Pick up an ice cube from a fast-food drink. There is a hole through the middle. It is on purpose.

title: Why do jar lids have a button that pops?
hook: Press the button on a new jar lid. It clicks. That click means something.

title: Why do you hear a click when you open a new jar?
hook: The sound is the proof the food inside has not been opened.
